en-US: Keep plugin panel close buttons in the header action row so they no longer overlap Refresh, Cancel, or Save.
Install and update GitHub plugins from public Release assets when api.github.com returns 401, 403, or 429.
Show only launcher commands on plugin marketplace cards, and keep the plugin toolbar menu to unique editor commands and dashboard panels.
Stop the memo-card hover tip from covering the New Note button.
Make diagram zoom percent editable, drop the Fit button, and keep large notes readable.
zh-CN: 把插件面板关闭按钮放进标题操作行，避免压住刷新、取消或保存。
当 GitHub REST API 返回 401、403 或 429 时，改为下载公开 Release 资源来安装和更新插件。
插件市场卡片只保留启动命令，工具栏菜单只保留不重复的编辑器命令和仪表盘面板。
避免笔记卡片悬停提示挡住「新建笔记」按钮。
图文档缩放改为可输入百分比，去掉适应画布按钮，并让大笔记保持可读。
